title: Oxyphenbutazone improves memory and learning impairments in LPS-induced neurotoxicity via modulating TGF-beta/NF-kappaB/IkappaB-alpha pathways: In silico and in vivo study.
authors: Alharbi, Khalid Saad; Afzal, Muhammad; Alenezi, Sattam Khulaif; ALQahtani, Reem; Alsahli, Tariq G; Imam, Faisal; Kazmi, Imran
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨Oxyphenbutazone在LPS诱导神经毒性中的抗炎与认知改善作用，虽含分子对接与动态模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白（NF-kB等），非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Neuroinflammation and oxidative stress play key roles in cognitive decline and memory impairments. This study employed a lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced neurotoxicity model and in silico methods, including in silico docking and dynamic simulations, to assess the therapeutic potential of Oxyphenbutazone (OPB). MATERIALS AND METHODS: Wistar rats were categorized as control, LPS-only section, LPS + OPB receiving low (35 mg/kg) and high (70 mg/kg) doses of OPB, and only OPB (70 mg/kg) doses. Behavioral assessments (Y-maze and Morris water tests) were used to assess cognitive ability. The levels of neuroinflammatory markers [Interleukin-6 (IL-6), IL-1beta, and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha)] and oxidative stress modulators [Superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione (GSH), catalase (CAT), and malondialdehyde (MDA)] were estimated. Additionally, transforming growth factor-beta (TGF-beta), nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB), and inhibitor of kappa B-alpha (IkappaB-alpha) levels were evaluated. In silico analyses, such as molecular docking and dynamic simulations, were used to evaluate the stability of OPB and target molecules. RESULTS: Cognitive performance improved after OPB treatment, and the levels of proinflammatory cytokines, antioxidants, TGF-beta, NF-kappaB, and IkappaB-alpha were restored. Additionally, in silico analyses illustrated favorable and stable interactions between OPB and the target molecules NF-kappaB and IkappaB-alpha. CONCLUSION: These findings suggest the therapeutic potential of OPB in mitigating neurotoxicity and the associated cognitive disabilities.
abstract_zh: 目的：神经炎症和氧化应激在认知衰退和记忆障碍中发挥关键作用。本研究采用脂多糖（LPS）诱导的神经毒性模型及计算机模拟方法，包括计算机模拟对接和动态模拟，以评估羟布宗（OPB）的治疗潜力。材料与方法：将Wistar大鼠分为对照组、仅LPS组、LPS+OPB低剂量（35 mg/kg）和高剂量（70 mg/kg）组，以及仅OPB（70 mg/kg）剂量组。采用行为学评估（Y迷宫和Morris水迷宫测试）来评价认知能力。检测神经炎症标志物[白细胞介素-6（IL-6）、IL-1β和肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）]及氧化应激调节因子[超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、谷胱甘肽（GSH）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）和丙二醛（MDA）]的水平。此外，还评估了转化生长因子-β（TGF-β）、核因子-κB（NF-κB）和κB抑制蛋白-α（IκB-α）的水平。采用计算机模拟分析，如分子对接和动态模拟，以评估OPB与靶分子的稳定性。结果：OPB治疗后认知表现改善，促炎细胞因子、抗氧化剂、TGF-β、NF-κB和IκB-α的水平得到恢复。此外，计算机模拟分析显示OPB与靶分子NF-κB和IκB-α之间存在有利且稳定的相互作用。结论：这些发现表明OPB在缓解神经毒性及相关认知障碍方面具有治疗潜力。
